'''Wiffa Zett''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was said to be part of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] army. She was [[Duel on Dathomir|defeated]] in a duel on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] by a a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|lone]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] sent by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wiffa Zett first appeared in the [[Sony]] video game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']]. She appears during a quest that is given to a player by Yoda.
